title: Autumn Apple Udon Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting udon noodle soup infused with the sweetness of autumnal apples, perfect for a chilly fall evening.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped green onions and cook until softened.
Add the vegetable broth, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Bring to a boil.
Add the udon noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Peel and dice the apples, then add them to the pot.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with toasted sesame seeds.
